description: Your home's wiring, finally explained. ⚡ Volts and Sense is where an electrical graduate answers the electrical questions US homeowners actually ask — why your breaker keeps tripping, what a GFCI does, whether that outlet is safe — in plain English, with clear animated diagrams. Every video tells you what's safe to handle yourself and when to call a licensed electrician. No scare tactics, no jargon, no guesswork. New videos every week. Subscribe and never feel lost in front of your breaker box again. ⚠️ Safety note: This channel is for education only. Electrical work can be dangerous. Always follow local codes and hire a licensed electrician for anything you're not sure about.
